anti_duplication_rules: All expert profile resolution goes through packages/svs_common/svs_common/expert_profiles.py:resolve_expert_profile; do not add route-local expert descriptor dictionaries.
All expert session, fork, feedback, and memory persistence goes through packages/svs_common/svs_common/expert_sessions.py; do not store expert memory inside OpenAI response payload JSON.

All expert chat/generation calls go through packages/svs_common/svs_common/expert_llm.py and the model-gateway boundary; do not call OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Ollama, Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode SDKs directly from route handlers.
All expert retrieval uses the existing retrieval/query_planner/search_lenses/openai_compat code paths; do not create a second search implementation for expert answers.
Feedback and memory events are not legal sources. Expert answers may cite only retrieved corpus/source-package material, never learned interaction memory by itself.
Caller-side MCP tools are thin HTTP adapters only; do not put retrieval planning, graph expansion, citation formatting, ACL checks, or provider credentials into the caller adapter.

tickets.expected_output: Expert profile registry and typed profile schemas are available; profiles bind to allowed vector stores and graph lenses under principal scope; list/resolve tests pass.
Alembic migration adds RLS-protected expert session/message/tool/retrieval/feedback/memory/fork tables; resume and fork work under tenant/business/API-key boundaries.
Provider-agnostic expert chat client exists with model-policy resolution, fixture provider, usage metadata, fallback behavior, and tests proving no embedding/rerank regressions.
`POST /v1/experts/{expert_id}/messages` and companion discovery/session routes return typed responses with cited answers, traces, session IDs, caveats, and provider metadata.
Expert engine executes bounded retrieval tool loops over semantic search, graph lenses, and citation expansion while preserving raw search endpoint behavior.
Feedback and memory governance stores scoped corrections, supports opt-in memory promotion/deletion, records audit visibility, and blocks memory from being cited as source law.
Caller docs and eval harness define `list_exais_experts`, `ask_exais_expert`, and `submit_expert_feedback`, with raw-search versus expert-session quality proof.
